name: CreateTrigger

parameters.help_en: The RAM role that is used by the event source such as Object Storage Service (OSS) to invoke the function. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53102.html
parameters.help_zh: 事件源（如OSS）调用函数所需的角色。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53102.html
parameters.name: invocation_role

parameters.help_en: The version or alias of the service
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the trigger event source. This parameter is optional for time triggers, HTTP triggers, and EventBridge-based triggers. This parameter is required for other types of triggers. For an EventBridge-based trigger, if you specify this parameter, the existing resources on the EventBridge side are associated with the trigger. **Do not specify the same sourceArn value for two different EventBridge triggers**. Otherwise, the update and delete operations of one trigger affect another
parameters.help_zh: 触发器事件源的Aliyun Resource Name。对于定时、HTTP和EventBridge类型的触发器可忽略该参数，其它类型触发器该参数为必填项。对于 EB 触发器，若主动填写该字段，表示将 EB 侧已存在资源关联到该触发器，注意，**两个不同 EB 触发器不要配置同一个 sourceArn**，否则触发器的更新/删除操作会相互影响
parameters.name: source_arn

parameters.help_en:
The trigger configurations. The configurations vary based on the trigger type. The following items list the configuration format for different triggers:

*   OSS triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html.
*   Simple Log Service triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html.
*   Time triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html.
*   HTTP triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html
*   Tablestore triggers: Specify the **SourceArnm** parameter and leave this parameter empty.
*   Alibaba Cloud CDN event triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415674.html.
*   Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) (SMQ) topic triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html.
*   EventBridge-based triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2508622.html
parameters.help_zh:
触发器配置，针对不同类型的触发器，配置有所不同。具体格式请参考如下对应的数据结构：

  - OSS触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html。
  - 日志服务触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html。
  - 定时触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html。
  - HTTP触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html。
  - Tablestore触发器：只需要填写完整的**SourceArn**参数便可, 这里无需额外配置，取值为空{}。
  - CDN事件触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415674.html。
  - MNS主题触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html。
  - EventBridge触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2508622.html
parameters.name: trigger_config

parameters.help_en: The name of the trigger. The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with a digit or a hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh: 触发器的名称。要求只能包含字母、数字、下划线\(_)和短划线\(-)。不能以数字、短划线\(-)开头，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: trigger_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the trigger. Valid values:

*   **oss**: OSS event trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62922.html.
*   **log**: Simple Log Service trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84386.html.
*   **timer**: time trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68172.html.
*   **http**: HTTP trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71229.html.
*   **tablestore**: Tablestore trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100092.html.
*   **cdn_events**: Alibaba Cloud CDN event triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73333.html.
*   **mns_topic**: SMQ topic triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97032.html.
*   **eventbridge**: EventBridge-based triggers
parameters.help_zh:
触发器的类型。具体取值和触发器类型对应关系如下所示：
  - **oss**：OSS触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62922.html。
  - **log**：日志服务触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84386.html。
  - **timer**：定时触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68172.html。
  - **http**：HTTP触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71229.html。
  - **tablestore**：Tablestore触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100092.html。
  - **cdn_events**：CDN事件触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73333.html。
  - **mns_topic**：MNS主题触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97032.html。
  - **eventbridge**：EventBridge触发器
parameters.name: trigger_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the request is initiated on the client. The format of the value is: **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**
parameters.help_zh: 客户端发起请求的时间。格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**
parameters.name: x_fc_date
